row.name: Core World Diplomat/Aristocrat
row.description: Characters from politically influential or affluent Core Worlds are often schooled in etiquette, negotiation, and the subtle art of persuasion. Benefits: Wealth (Comfortable, 10 points) (representing their privileged upbringing or access to resources). Status 1 (5 points) (representing their social standing or political connections). +1 to Diplomacy (IQ/Hard) and Savoir-Faire (IQ/Easy) skills. (These bonuses apply after buying skill levels.) These skills allow for effective manipulation of galactic politics, charming enemies, and leveraging social standing, often in ways that benefit one's faction or personal interests, sometimes at the expense of the less powerful.
